method: Actual shipped native settings/action scripts in a Node VM with DOM tree append/detach semantics. Native gameplay/restore uses the existing CPU renderer readiness fixture. No browser, accessibility screen reader or GPU execution.

checks.name: Actual delivered scripts include detached native action and one Settings runtime
Settings/action integration is byte-idempotent
Start action and test telemetry are absent from the battle DOM before boot
Native boot remains successful

warnings: 저장소 내레이션은 부분 제공입니다. 누락 또는 원문 불일치 장면은 텍스트로 진행합니다.

checks.name: The native title exposes a generic Settings button while hospital start stays inside Settings
Native Settings mounts the original start/status and diagnostics under its panel section
Settings action is a native keyboard button with live status association
Closing initial Settings returns to the native title and removes hospital controls
A failed renderer refuses direct restore and preserves the exact failure reason
Settings button uses native hospital restore/admission and retains all three doors
Starting hospital returns to combat without any floating test button or diagnostics
Settings can be opened again after native start without hiding the action
A failed renderer keeps Settings/Menu/Escape reachable while still blocking battle input
Repeated Settings opens preserve one action and one event handler
Changing from Settings to another native panel detaches the test controls
Closing menus leaves only the native battle HUD in the document
A native HUD resume also detaches controls if a caller bypasses closePanel
Native normal new game in a fresh session still enters the first safe refuge
Settings relocation preserves prior test saves and adds no serialized UI fields
Native error ledger stays clear
